name.ja: HGUC 1/144 フルアーマーガンダム７号機

description.ja: PS3用ソフト「機動戦士ガンダム戦記」の主役機“フルアーマーガンダム 7号機”がHGUCで早くも立体化！ 外装の複雑な面構成から緻密なモールドまで精密に再現。 頭部はスライド成形により合わせ目のない一体成型。 ヒジ、ヒザには二重関節、股関節には前後スイング機構を採用。抜群のプロポーションと広い可動域で様々なアクションシーンを再現可能。 テールバインダーは独立可動。
description.en: The main character of the PS3 software "Mobile Suit Gundam Senki ", " Full Armor Gundam Unit 7", has already been made into a three-dimensional figure with HGUC! Precisely reproduced from the complex surface structure of the exterior to the detailed mold. The head is molded in one piece with no seams due to slide molding. The elbows and knees have double joints, and the hip joint has a back and forth swing mechanism. With its outstanding proportions and wide range of motion, you can reproduce various action scenes. The tail binder can be moved independently.
